subject: Request: vendor operator roster + regional fallback evidence
messages:
From: FinSecure Compliance <compliance@finsecure.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finsecure.com
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Detailed vendor roster + regional fallback mapping

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking our RFP. As part of the security appendix we need a complete roster of all third-party operators (subprocessors), inclusive of the following for each vendor:
- Legal entity name
- Primary country of operation and data regions touched
- Access scope (admin/production/support)
- Whether keys or logs are stored by the vendor (yes/no) and encryption-at-rest details
- SLA and fallback options (what happens if vendor becomes unavailable)

We also need an explicit mapping of which cloud regions you use for US customer data and a short continuity plan in case of a cloud provider region deprecation (example: planned AWS region retirement or Azure outage).

Please include any SOC2 / ISO attestation references you can share. We're on a tight review cycle and would like to receive a consolidated response and evidence by end of week. We're attaching our RFP template for your convenience.

Thanks,
Dana Park
Senior Compliance Manager
FinSecure Bank
compliance@finsecure.com

Attachment: FinSecure-RFP-Security-Appendix-2028.xlsx
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: FinSecure Compliance <compliance@finsecure.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Detailed vendor roster + regional fallback mapping

Dana —

Appreciate the clear list. We're compiling a consolidated evidence pack. High level:
- We'll provide a vendor roster (attached) with column-level details you requested.
- For each vendor we indicate region(s) of processing and the contractual subprocessor clause reference.
- For cloud regions: US-West-2 and US-East-1 are primary for US accounts; we maintain cross-region replication and an automated failover playbook.
- SOC 2/ISO: we will reference the attestation PDFs and provide cert-level summaries and dates.

Action items on our side (timeline in parentheses):
1) Deliver spreadsheet with roster + evidence links (EOD Thu)
2) Short narrative on fallback scenarios per major subprocessor (EOD Thu)
3) Set a 30-minute walkthrough with your team to review edge cases (Fri 11am PT suggested)

Attached: redwood-2028-subprocessor-roster.xlsx (master roster), network-ownership-matrix.pdf (mapping of cloud/operator responsibilities).

If you have any vendor-specific templated questions we should prioritize, please flag them now so we can include targeted artifacts.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

I can take owner for the operator access columns and the encryption-at-rest details. Kim, can you confirm AWS KMS scopes for the encryption notes?
